common: Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high fidelity, finished, flat full-screen 16:9 landscape Japanese game UI image, target 1920 x 1080. This is a design for the existing game MOJI Fighter X. A consistent ivory washi-paper background (#F2EBDB), subtle fine fibers and light tan speckles; dark ink (#20211F), vermilion red (#BA3C2D) for the player and primary actions, indigo (#334C78) for COM. Crisp double thin rectangular outer frame with four small square ink ornaments at corners, inset generously from the image edges. Minimal Japanese print/arcade aesthetic. Strong legible Japanese sans-serif text for labels, energetic Japanese brush calligraphy for oversized weapon kanji. Black stick-figure fighters with circular heads and simple limbs wielding large kanji weapons; no realistic people, no clothing. Strict rectangular cards with thin double borders, square corners, straight dividers, numbered black tabs; generous padding. Buttons are large rectangular paper/red/indigo/ink blocks with crisp dark offset shadows fully contained within margins. Standard header: a black back button upper left, English screen identifier centered between thin rules, a black button reading 「設定」 toward upper right, and 「MOJI Fighter X」 at far right; horizontal header divider. Match existing game screenshots' restrained paper-and-ink style. Every screen fills the entire image. No device mockup, no perspective, no browser chrome, no watermarks, no invented logos, no rounded cards, no gradients or neon. All specified Japanese must be legible and exact; avoid extraneous filler text.

screens.title: 01 メニュー
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「01 / MODE SELECT」; back 「← 戻る」. Large centered heading 「遊び方を選ぶ」. Four equal tall mode cards in one row, from left: 「01 バトル」 with two stick fighters and VS, 「02 トーナメント」 with a clean symmetric trophy and eight-entry bracket, 「03 お題バトル」 with fighters holding 「一」 and 「刀」, 「04 文字ドラフト」 with three playing-card style paper tiles showing brush 「火」「盾」「龍」 and a small NEW red stamp. Captions respectively 「文字を自由にカスタマイズ」「8人の大会で優勝を目指す」「条件を攻略して腕を試す」「候補から選んだ文字で戦う」. Buttons respectively 「バトルへ →」 red, 「大会へ →」 indigo, 「お題を選ぶ →」 red, 「ドラフトへ →」 red. Thin red outer hover frame only around the fourth card, with a subtle arrow cursor on that card indicating an active hover. Two wide footer tiles, left 「05 友人と対戦」「ルームコードでつながる」「対戦へ →」 with simple linked red/blue person silhouettes, right 「06 称号」「獲得 33 / 56」「称号を見る →」 with a round ink brush badge. Fit every button and shadow inside its card frame. No title-screen settings controls; this is the mode menu.

screens.title: 02 モード説明
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「DRAFT / GUIDE」; back 「← メニュー」. Heading 「文字ドラフト」 and subtitle 「引いた文字で、勝ち筋をつくる。」. Upper feature illustration shows a spread of six paper letter cards 「火」「刀」「龍」「盾」「風」「雷」 with player-red and COM-indigo small fighter silhouettes flanking them. Lower half has three equal numbered rule panels: 「01 文字を選ぶ」 / 「6文字の共通候補から選択」; 「02 構成を決める」 / 「字体・サイズ・持ち方を調整」; 「03 先に2勝で勝利」 / 「毎ラウンド、新しい候補が登場」. Simple card, wrench-free glyph-and-grip, and two red victory dots icons respectively. Below panels a centered note 「選ばれた文字は相手が使えません。先攻はラウンドごとに交代。」. Bottom large vermilion CTA 「ドラフトを始める →」 and secondary paper button 「メニューへ」. Clear hierarchy and broad negative space.

screens.title: 03 文字ドラフト
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「DRAFT / SELECT」; back 「← 戻る」. Top score strip 「第2ラウンド」, 「あなた 1勝」 red, 「COM 0勝」 indigo. Main heading 「文字を選ぶ」 and status subtitle 「あなたの番です」 red. Main area: six equal large paper kanji candidate cards in a 3-column x 2-row grid on the left two thirds, exact order top 「火」「刀」「龍」 bottom 「盾」「風」「雷」. Every card has a very large dark ink brush kanji and compact labels 「威力」「速度」「リーチ」 each with five tiny square meter cells; these are relative design-example meters, no numerals. Fire card is actively selected with red brush glyph, thin red outer frame, small 「選択中」 badge. Shield card is unavailable, grey and muted, small indigo 「COM 選択済み」 ribbon and checkmark, its meters subdued. Other cards plain ivory with ink outlines. The right third has two stacked selected-letter panels: upper 「あなた」 with a red 「火」, black stick fighter weapon preview, status 「選択中」; lower 「COM」 with indigo 「盾」, preview, status 「選択済み」. Bottom note 「COMが選んだ文字は選べません」. Primary wide red button 「火を選ぶ →」 at bottom right; no reroll button. Layout not crowded, large enough Japanese labels.

screens.title: 04 構成調整
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「DRAFT / CUSTOMIZE」; back 「← ドラフト」. Header score strip 「第2ラウンド　あなた 1勝 / COM 0勝」. Heading 「選んだ文字を、武器にする。」. Left third is a large bordered preview panel titled 「あなたの武器」 with a bold vermilion brush 「火」 held by a black stick fighter, baseline beneath feet, smaller locked label 「文字：火　固定」. Three compact horizontal performance meters 「威力」「速度」「リーチ」 below preview. Right two thirds: well spaced stacked settings rows in bordered panels. 「字体」 buttons 「明朝」「ゴシック」「筆」 with 「筆」 selected ink; 「サイズ」 buttons 「S」「M」「L」「XL」 with M selected red; 「持ち方」 buttons 「縦」「横」「両手」 with 両手 selected red; 「戦闘スタイル」 buttons 「攻め」「守り」「カウンター」 with 攻め selected red. A bottom special-move row 「必殺技　火炎連斬」 with paper button 「必殺技を選ぶ →」. Small opponent preview strip 「相手 COM：盾」 with indigo shield kanji, text 「Lサイズ / 守り」. Footer hint 「文字は変更できません。構成を工夫して戦おう。」 and a large primary red CTA 「この構成で戦う →」, secondary 「ドラフトへ戻る」. All action buttons lie inside safe outer frame. Do not show any editable letter input field.

screens.title: 05 VS画面
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「DRAFT / VS」; back 「← 構成調整」. Centered top strip 「第2ラウンド　あなた 1勝 / COM 0勝」. Symmetric dramatic but minimal versus composition: large vermilion brush 「火」 and black stick fighter on the left, large indigo brush 「盾」 and black stick fighter mirrored on the right; weapons look like the glyphs themselves. Huge ink 「VS」 in the center with a sparse pale ink brush circle behind it. Under left art a red rectangular team label 「あなた」, then 「火 / 筆 / M」 and 「両手 / 攻め」. Under right art an indigo label 「COM」, then 「盾 / 筆 / L」 and 「縦 / 守り」. Two small victory markers beside each team name: one filled red + one empty for player, two empty for COM. Near bottom subtitle 「選んだ一文字で、勝負。」. Large centered red bottom button 「対戦開始 →」. Keep balanced negative space and identical scale of the two columns, sharp readable typography, no extra rules or stats.

screens.title: 06 バトル
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「DRAFT / BATTLE」; back 「← 戻る」. Slim mode ribbon beneath header 「第2ラウンド　あなた 1勝 / COM 0勝」. Preserve existing MOJI Fighter X battle HUD: player block red square 「火」 left, label 「あなた / 火 / 攻め」, long red HP bar with 「72 / 100」; mirrored opponent indigo square 「盾」, label 「COM / 盾 / 守り」, indigo HP bar 「58 / 110」. Large centered timer 「TIME 42」 and small outlined 「AUTO」 badge. Below player HP a compact bordered intervention area with red 「必殺」 progress meter at 65 percent and 「声援」 meter full, two buttons 「必殺 火炎連斬」 muted disabled and 「声援」 red available. Mirrored COM area with indigo 「必殺」 and 「声援」 meters. Main arena fills broad lower-middle region: faint pale brush ring on washi, black stick fighter holding a large red 火 weapon on the left, black stick fighter holding a large indigo 盾 on right, fighters spaced naturally mid-exchange above a single straight ink ground line. Small red 「声援中！」 near player, no blood or complex particles. Footer paper controls 「一時停止」, speed selectors 「0.5×」「1×」「2×」「4×」 with 1× ink selected, and 「詳細」. All footer buttons within the frame. Battle looks like a readable 2D kanji-weapon spectator game rather than a cinematic painting.

screens.title: 07 結果画面
screens.prompt: Screen identifier 「DRAFT / RESULT」; back 「← メニュー」. Top centered label 「第2ラウンド」. Huge centered vermilion brush headline 「あなたの勝利！」. Under headline a wide symmetric score ribbon: left 「あなた」 red and two filled red win markers; center score 「2 - 0」; right 「COM」 indigo and two empty win markers. This is the final match result after two wins; small centered stamp 「ドラフト勝者」 under score. Two equal large bordered panels below. Left numbered 「01 対戦結果」: victorious black stick fighter raising a red 火 above the head, defeated black stick fighter next to indigo 盾, text 「決着時間 18.4秒」 and 「残りHP 72 / 100」 in a divided stats row. Right numbered 「02 ドラフトの記録」: two clean compact round-history rows 「第1ラウンド　一 VS 刀　勝利」 and 「第2ラウンド　火 VS 盾　勝利」, each with small red/indigo brush glyphs and a red victory square; beneath them a short copy 「選んだ文字と構成が、勝利をつかんだ。」. Footer two large contained buttons: red primary 「もう一度ドラフト →」 and paper secondary 「メニューへ」. Avoid inventing currencies or achievement rewards. The same panel arrangement should also suit between-round results by replacing footer primary with 次のドラフトへ; render ONLY the final-match state described, no multiple screen collage.

refinements.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the red 「声援中！」 callout and its short decorative strokes in the left middle arena area of this exact Japanese game UI. Remove that callout and its decorative strokes, restoring seamless matching ivory washi paper behind it. The player cheer gauge is full and the 声援 button is available, so do not show an active-cheer annotation. Preserve absolutely everything else: all HUD text and numbers, HP/gauge bars, buttons, fire and shield glyph weapons, fighter poses, faint brush circle, typography, frame, paper texture, colors, scoreboard, dimensions and composition. Do not add new text or move any elements.
